title: Write-Ahead Logging
summary: SQLite implements atomic commit and rollback with either a rollback journal or a write-ahead log. In WAL mode, changes are appended to a separate WAL file instead of overwriting the database file.

key_points.claim: SQLite implements atomic commit and rollback with either a rollback journal or a write-ahead log
